result.rationale: The diff wires `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` to a controller whose `update` action only re-serializes `@embedding` (an OpenStruct of EmbeddableHost.all) and never reads or persists request parameters, so a successful HTTP 200 discards any submitted input. The JS `saveChanges` action calls `embedding.update({})`, confirming the flow is meant to save. The mechanism described is verifiable and real; severity is tempered only because no template currently triggers saveChanges, so confidence is moderate.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` is wired to `put "customize/embedding"` but the action does not read params or persist anything; it just re-renders `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`). On the client, `admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({});`, but `embedding.hbs` currently has no save button invoking it, and all actual mutations (hosts) are persisted via `EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save(props)` / `destroyRecord`). So this is a real, diff-grounded concern about a misleading/placeholder PUT endpoint and unused save action, but not a currently user-visible defect in the shown UI.
